title_en: Fall 2026 Master's and Doctoral Thesis Examination Public Presentation Schedule (Subject to Change)
summary: The schedules for the Fall 2026 master's thesis examination public presentations and doctoral public presentations (preliminary examination) are provided in the attached files, which were not read for this translation. Attendees, including students enrolled in the master's/doctoral seminar, must check the attached files again on the day of the examination, because times, locations and other details may change at any time. Questions may be directed to the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
applies_to: Master's and doctoral students presenting in the Fall 2026 thesis examination public presentations, and all attendees, including students enrolled in the master's/doctoral seminar (석박사세미나). Attendees must check the attached schedule on the day of the examination.
conditions: The schedules in the attached files may be changed at any time, including times and locations.
Attendees, including students enrolled in the master's/doctoral seminar, must check the attached files on the day of the examination itself.
steps: Read the attached files for the schedule: '2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf' (master's examinations) and '2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf' (doctoral preliminary examinations). The content of these attachments was not read for this translation.
On the day of the examination, check the attached files again for any change in time or location before attending.
For questions, contact the department office (Building 301, Room 319); contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
★(Changes at any time) Fall 2026 Master's/Doctoral Thesis Examination Public Presentation Schedule

We announce the schedule of the Fall 2026 master's/doctoral thesis examination public presentations.

1. Master's public presentation schedule
- Refer to the attached file (the content may change at any time).

2. Doctoral public presentation (preliminary examination, 초심) schedule
- Refer to the attached file (the content may change at any time).

3. Notes
- The public presentation schedule (attached files) is updated at any time. As times, locations and other details may change, attendees, including students enrolled in the master's/doctoral seminar (석박사세미나), must check the attached files on the day of the examination as well.

4. Inquiries
- Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person, phone number and email address are given in the original notice.

Attachments (2):
- 2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf (153 KB) (Fall 2026 doctoral preliminary examination schedule)
- 2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf (187 KB) (Fall 2026 master's examination schedule)

[Note: The contents of the attached files were not read for this translation.]
